about.title: About Redacto
about.summary: Redacto ifata amakuru bwite (amazina, imeri, indangamuntu, amabanga muri code) mbere yo kuyashyira muri ChatGPT, Claude cyangwa Gemini, hanyuma ukayahinduranya n'ahantu ushobora kugarura nyuma.
about.local: Detection ikora byose ku gikoresho cyawe. Nta kintu na kimwe ushyira hanze ya mushakisha, kandi nta telemetry ihari.
about.fork: Redacto is a free, non-commercial fork of Privacy Guardrail from DFKI. It is not affiliated with or approved by DFKI.
support.title: Support
support.sensitive: For sensitive reports, use the private instructions in SECURITY.md. The contact is

legal.termsSoon.title: Amabwiriza agenga imikoreshereze y'ibicuruzwa azatangazwa mu gihe cya vuba.
legal.disclaimer: Redacto is assistive only and can miss or mis-flag sensitive content. Always review text before you send it.

pasteReview.title: Gusimbuza amakuru y'umuntu ku giti cye
pasteReview.label: Mu gihe amakuru y'umuntu ku giti cye abonetse
pasteReview.body: Manual itanga ibisimbuza mu idirishya rya pop-up, aho ushobora kubisuzuma mbere yo gupatsa. Automatic isimbuza ibintu pop-up yahitamo ako kanya, utarinze kuyerekana.
cancel.title: Paste scan cancellation
cancel.label: Mu gihe cyo gukuraho scan
cancel.body: Choose what Redacto does with the pending paste after you explicit cancel a running scan. "Paste without checking" bypasses personal-data detection for that paste.
code.title: Code blocks
code.hint: Secrets in code and code-area handling
code.secrets.hintBefore: Flags API keys and tokens (AWS, GitHub, OpenAI, Stripe, Slack, Google, JWT), private key blocks, credentials in assignments and connection strings, internal hostnames such as
code.rename.hint1: Renames the classes, functions, variables, fields and parameters that pasted code declares, the same way everywhere:
code.rename.hint5: . Imported and library names stay. Names in which Local AI finds personal data keep a typed placeholder instead (
code.rename.hint6: ). Copy code back from a reply rerestore the original names. Turning this on also turns on secret detection.
code.shareLanguage: Mujye mukoresha ururimi rw'icyizere aho ari ho hose
code.shareLanguage.hintBefore: Mu gihe umuntu akoze icyangombwa cy'ubuziranenge bw'ibinyabiziga ashyirwa mu byiciro by'ubudehe (Ifoto/Umurengezi R)
code.shareLanguage.hintAfter: , or unmistakable syntax), every other block and fragment in it is read with that language too: its syntax and its official names, which are not renamed. Blocks recognized as different languages keep their own.
code.highlight: Igishushanyo mbonera cy'ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda, kigaragaza ururimi rw'ikinyarwanda.
code.highlight.hintBefore: Mu gihe umuhango wo gushyingura Kizito Mihigo ushyizwe ku rutonde rw'abakandida b'ishyaka riri ku rwego rwo hejuru (Ifoto/Umurengezi R)
code.highlight.hintAfter: , or unmistakable syntax), code in every field of the side panel is shown with that language's syntax coloring: the text to anonymize and its result, and the answer to restore and the restored text. Short fragments of the answer are colored in the language of the original paste. Blocks recognized as another language keep their own.
code.skip.hintBefore: When on, detections inside fenced markdown blocks and
code.skip.hintAfter: regions move to a collapsed disclosure in the overlay instead of appear at the top level. Inline backticks are always scanned.
search.title: Ishakisha kuri interineti
search.label: Kurinda gushakisha kuri interineti
search.body1Before: Igenzura ibyo ushyira mu gasanduku k'ishakisha ka moteri ishakisha, hanyuma ikagumana buri shakisha kugeza igihe ikibazo cyayo kigenzuwe. Amakuru bwite wemeye asimburwa n'ibibanza nk'ibi
search.body1After: Mbere yo kohereza ishakisha. Turning this on asks the browser for access to these search sites.
search.body2: Not covered: searches typed into the browser's address bar, which never reach the page, and the suggestions a search engine requests while you type. Turn off search suggestions in the engine's settings for the strongest protection.
search.declined: Kwinjira mu bigo byo gushakisha ntibyemewe, bityo umutekano ukomeza guhagarara.
debugCard.title: Tag: Bye Bye System
debugCard.debug.hintAfter: ) and reveals testing controls that simulate compatibility states without restarting the browser.
debugCard.warning: These buttons write directly to pg_system_check and the Local AI setting. Use only when testing — to return to the real passive check, click "Clear & re-run passive check".
